name: Axiom Systems Field Intelligence Jacket
description:
A slim-cut technical jacket in charcoal or dark slate that reads, at a glance, like an expensive casual blazer. The Axiom Field Intelligence is built for people whose work requires them to look presentable while carrying gear — it has eleven discrete interior pockets of varying sizes, a hidden pass-through slot in the right chest for tablet or document retrieval, and a concealed hood that tucks into the collar. The exterior has four standard pockets. The fabric is a matte technical weave that resists IR imaging, rendering the wearer's thermal signature slightly diffuse.

Axiom Systems is a Tier 4 corporate intelligence and security consultancy that manufactures a small line of purpose-built garments for internal use and licensed external sale. The jacket is available to vetted buyers with appropriate clearance verification. It's worn by corporate investigators, high-end private security liaisons, and the kind of Tier 4 professional whose job description is deliberately vague.
functionality: Passive IR signature diffusion reduces thermal imaging clarity. Eleven concealed interior pockets. No active electronics.
what_it_says: Your job requires preparation for contingencies you're not going to discuss.
story_hooks: An Axiom Field Intelligence jacket has turned up on a body in the Shelf — the jacket's purchase records are classified, and three different parties want to know how it got there.
The IR-diffuse weave is based on technology that was stolen from a university research lab a decade ago; the original researchers have recently hired legal counsel.
A corporate intelligence analyst has been passing documents through the jacket's hidden slot at a regular lunch spot, and someone just started sitting at the next table every time.

physical_description.visual_profile: A deceptively refined slim-cut blazer that conceals technical sophistication beneath a veneer of corporate elegance. Sharp, angular lines with a slightly tapered waist. Reads as expensive casual wear at first glance—the kind of jacket worn to client meetings and upscale venues. The matte finish gives it an almost non-reflective quality, absorbing light rather than catching it.
physical_description.fit: Slim, tailored cut with enough room for concealed gear without visible bulk. Shoulders sit cleanly; sleeves taper to the wrist. The cut is deliberate—professional enough for boardrooms, mobile enough for fieldwork. Not restrictive, but precise.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte technical weave—a high-grade synthetic blend engineered for IR resistance and thermal diffusion. Surface has a subtle texture, almost fabric-like despite synthetic composition. Lightweight but dense, with micro-ripstop reinforcement invisible to the casual eye.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, matte surface with a faint tactile weave pattern. Under close inspection, the fabric shows subtle grid-work and reinforced stress points. No shine; the material seems to absorb and dampen rather than reflect.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal or dark slate gray—a neutral that sits between corporate black and practical gray. Minimal contrast. No visible branding or accent colors. All closures and hardware in matte gunmetal or dark anodized finishes.
physical_description.closures: Concealed magnetic snaps down the front placket—completely flush when fastened, no visible buttons or studs. Internal friction-fit webbing at cuffs for secure layering. Hidden anchor points throughout.
distinctive_features: Eleven discrete interior pockets of varying depths and dimensions—some shallow for documents, others deep for tools or electronics
Hidden pass-through slot in right chest panel for tablet or classified documents—accessible without opening jacket
Concealed hood that compresses and tucks seamlessly into a reinforced collar cavity—impossible to detect when stowed
Four exterior pockets designed for ergonomic weight distribution
IR-resistant weave that diffuses thermal signature—visible to thermal imaging but as a blurred, less distinct target
Subtle Axiom Systems identifier—small woven mark on interior neck tag, barely visible
Reinforced stress points at shoulders, seams, and pocket edges with internal ballistic micro-weave
Cuff design allows for integrated watch or biometric scanner without external modification
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury professional—restricted access, vetted purchase only. The price point and controlled distribution mark this as high-end corporate equipment, not consumer retail.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by corporate investigators, private security liaisons, intelligence operatives, and Tier 4 professionals whose work exists in gray zones between boardroom and field. The wearer is someone trusted with sensitive information and equipped for mobile fieldwork. Signifies discretion, authority, and capability without broadcasting any of it.
physical_description.condition_typical: Always maintained in pristine condition—these jackets are too expensive and too deliberately designed to show wear. Owners keep them immaculate. Over time, the matte finish may dull slightly from use, but they're typically rotated and professionally cleaned.

image_prompt: Slim-fit charcoal technical blazer on a high-cheekboned Tier 4 corporate model with subtle augmentations—maybe a barely-visible neural port at the temple or augmented eye. Model stands in a moody corporate interior, dark glass and steel behind them. Side-angle shot emphasizing the clean lines and tailored fit. Soft blue-tinted spotlighting from above, creating subtle shadow play across the matte fabric surface. The jacket's thermal-resistant weave should appear as an imperceptible shimmer, almost like it's absorbing the light. No visible pockets or hardware in the foreground—all design reads as clean, minimal, intentional. Dark minimalist backdrop. --ar 2:3 --v 6
